tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch and parse full article content by URL (params: url — defaults to current/latest article) -> {title, url, author, date, categories, tags, content, headings}

url.description: Full URL of the article to read (defaults to current or latest article)

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: List recent AI news, articles, and tutorials from the blog (params: limit=10) -> list [{title, url, excerpt, author, date}]

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: List practical AI video tutorials and guides (params: limit=10) -> list [{title, video_url}]

limit.description: Maximum number of video items to return

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search AI articles, news, and guides (params: query, navigate=false) -> navigates or returns list [{title, url, excerpt, date}]

navigate.description: Whether to navigate the browser to the search results page
